name: Scheduled task
why: A recurring job, from its README row to a run that ends clean
ideal: Each recurring job is a named task that starts on time, ends without error and loads few connectors.

steps.name: Define
steps.rule: Each recurring job is a row in the template README.

steps.name: Fire
steps.rule: A run starts within ten minutes of its time.

steps.name: Connect
steps.rule: A task loads only the connectors it needs.

steps.name: Run
steps.rule: The latest run of every task ends without an error.
